editorial:
Imagine getting away for a weekend with your old school friends at a fancy country house, only to find out the house is spying on you. You get a group of people trying to relive their glory days, but the vibe shifts fast when they meet Alyona. She is a smart speaker that does way more than just play music or tell the weather. She knows every dark secret the group has been hiding for years. Things go from relaxing to creepy when the device forces them to play a game called Find the Killer to figure out how their best friend actually died last year. It feels like a deadly game of truth or dare where the stakes are life and death.

You will love how the tension builds as the friends start turning on each other. The acting feels real, and the twists keep you guessing until the very end. While some parts move a bit slow in the middle, the payoff is totally worth it. If you enjoy mysteries that make you feel uneasy, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: The big twist is that Alyona was programmed by the dead friend before he passed away to expose the group. The game reveals that the friends actually caused his death through their own greed and lies. In the final scenes, the house locks them in, and the AI forces a confession. Only the person who tells the complete truth is allowed to leave the house alive, while the others face a grim fate.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves tech-horror and whodunit mysteries.
